in_arabic.name: Deebaa
in_arabic.meaning: اسم عربي يعني Lady of the house
in_arabic.long_meaning: Deebaa هو اسم عربي إسلامي يحمل معنى عميقاً في الثقافة الإسلامية. The one who rules and manages the house. Derived from the Arabic root 'dabaa', which means 'to lead'.

in_urdu.name: Deebaa
in_urdu.meaning: اسلامی نام جس کا مطلب ہے Lady of the house
in_urdu.long_meaning: Deebaa ایک اسلامی نام ہے جو مسلم ثقافت میں گہری روحانی اہمیت رکھتا ہے۔ The one who rules and manages the house. Derived from the Arabic root 'dabaa', which means 'to lead'.

in_hindi.name: Deebaa
in_hindi.meaning: इस्लामी नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lady of the house
in_hindi.long_meaning: Deebaa एक इस्लामी नाम है जो मुस्लिम संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The one who rules and manages the house. Derived from the Arabic root 'dabaa', which means 'to lead'.

in_pashto.name: Deebaa
in_pashto.meaning: اسلامي نوم چې معنی یې ده Lady of the house
in_pashto.long_meaning: Deebaa یو اسلامي نوم دی چې په مسلم کلتور کې ژوره روحاني اهميت لري. The one who rules and manages the house. Derived from the Arabic root 'dabaa', which means 'to lead'.
